correctness.rationale: The published MSD interval construction partitions irrational-circle endpoints from negative indices -(c+1),-(c+2). At c=F_k-2, their right-shift chains share all indices -F_(k-1),...,-F_2, yielding k distinct endpoints and <=k states. The lower bound uses the rotation identity F_t phi-F_(t+1)=(-1)^(t+1)phi^-t and the Fibonacci-word coding interval (gamma,2gamma). The k valid prefixes 0,F_2,...,F_(k-1), plus q=4 when k odd or q=6 when k even, have pairwise inequivalent residual functions under suffices of zeroes: F_i prefixes have different last disagreements with baseline at depths k-1-i; q matches F_2 after positive depths but disagrees at zero depth. This proves >=k by Myhill–Nerode on allowed inputs, hence exact k. A newly written Zeckendorf/rotation integer checker verified 31 individual shifts k=5..35 and all k residual distinctions; they corroborate the all-k inequalities.

final_claim: For every integer k>=5, the minimal accessible MSD-first output DFAO computing the shifted Fibonacci word f(n+F_k-2) on valid Zeckendorf representations has exactly k states; leading zeros may be admitted.
limitations: k>=5 only and shifts c=F_k-2; no minimal-state classification for arbitrary shift.
